caption: The drawing depicts a tan or beige ceramic pitcher with ornate details, such as a decorated handle and scalloped rim. The pitcher features black-and-white illustrations on its surface, including two identical log cabins labeled "THE OHIO FARMER" near the upper part of the body. Below the cabins, there are two oval portraits of a man labeled "W.H. HARRISON," each enclosed by a laurel wreath. Underneath each portrait, there is an eagle with outspread wings, clutching what appears to be branch-like objects. The entire image is set against a plain, light background, and the pitcher is shown at an angle to display the main ornamentation on its surface. The artist's signature and the notation "¾ size P. Ward" appear in the lower right corner.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
